name: Stanton Carpet Corp
information: Principal Data Engineer leading enterprise data platform strategy and implementation. Architect Microsoft Fabric workspaces, Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion pipelines, and business intelligence solutions integrating ERP, CRM, and operational systems. Partner with executive leadership to define data strategy, modernization roadmaps, and enterprise analytics initiatives. Design Lakehouse architectures and scalable data models across Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, and Azure. Enable AI and advanced analytics initiatives by building governed, scalable data foundations.

name: AnswerRocket
information: Senior Data Engineer (AI Focused) leading data discovery and ETL architecture across 20+ enterprise clients. Led migration of legacy infrastructure to a Databricks Lakehouse, rebuilding 100+ historical ETL pipelines using PySpark, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog — reducing pipeline development time by 40% and enabling scalable Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data models. Built and evolved three generations of ETL frameworks — from embedded monolithic pipelines to a modular multi-cloud connector framework (AWS S3/Redshift, Azure Synapse/Blob, Databricks Unity Catalog), and finally to a PySpark-native Medallion architecture with Delta Live Tables and Change Data Feed streaming. Delivered 12+ production ETL implementations for CPG enterprise clients including Beam Suntory, Kimberly-Clark, Coty, Wella, National Beverage, and Genpact/Mondelez — processing billions of rows from Nielsen, Kantar, IRI, SPINS, and Toluna data sources. Architected a config-driven ETL platform on Azure + Snowflake ingesting 40+ API endpoints and 69 Excel mapping definitions through a Medallion architecture powering Power BI DirectQuery dashboards. Terraform + GitHub Actions CI/CD for infrastructure automation.

name: Prime Clerk (Kroll)
information: Key role in modernizing the company's data infrastructure to a centralized Microsoft-based platform. Designed ETL pipelines across departments, optimized SQL queries and procedures, built 80+ Excel automations with VBA/Power Query, and developed C#/.NET and Python tools to streamline data transformation workflows.

name: SwipeSwipe
information: Founding Lead Data Engineer building GenAI-powered data infrastructure. Led team of 5 engineers, implemented Spark pipelines with Airflow orchestration, and developed modular ETL architecture using Gemini, OpenAI, and Claude AI APIs.

name: In-House
information: Data Engineer II establishing GCP infrastructure with BigQuery and AirByte. Set up Hadoop clusters, designed data models with DBT, created Metabase dashboards, and mentored new team members.
